article_content: The Pentagon has announced that the USS Gerald R. Ford and its carrier strike group will remain in the eastern Mediterranean for a longer period than initially planned. This extension, approved by Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin, is part of the US response to heightened tensions following recent Hamas attacks in Israel. The Gerald R. Ford carrier strike group—including the Ford itself, USS Normandy, USS Thomas Hudner, USS Ramage, USS Carney, and USS Roosevelt—was nearing the end of a six-month deployment when the decision was made. Officials have not released a specific new end date. A second carrier strike group, led by the USS Dwight D. Eisenhower, will also move into the region to provide additional support. Both groups bring significant naval and air power, reinforcing US and allied military presence. Additional American fighter jets and British military resources are also being deployed, with these actions intended to support Israel and deter escalation by countries like Iran and groups such as Hezbollah. Defense officials have raised the readiness level of about 2,000 US personnel, allowing for a rapid response if needed, though no immediate deployment is planned. According to Pentagon spokesperson Sabrina Singh, these precautions are a reaction to the shifting security environment in the Middle East. Hamas’s attacks on southern Israel killed over 1,300 people and injured upwards of 4,000, prompting Israel to launch airstrikes across Gaza. The United Nations reports that more than 2,800 Palestinians have been killed and nearly 11,000 injured amid heavy bombardment and widespread destruction. Israel’s directive for residents to evacuate northern Gaza has drawn criticism from human rights advocates, who highlight the worsening humanitarian crisis. Israeli leaders suggest a ground assault may be in preparation, but no timeline has been disclosed. President Joe Biden plans to visit both Israel and Jordan to meet with several regional leaders, including Israel’s Prime Minister, Jordan’s King, Egypt’s President, and the Palestinian Authority’s President. US Secretary of State Antony Blinken said Biden’s trip comes at a crucial time and emphasizes America’s steadfast support for Israel’s security.
translated_content: 미 국방부는 USS 제럴드 R. 포드 항공모함과 그 전단이 당초 예정보다 더 오래 동지중해에 머무르게 된다고 발표했습니다. 이번 연장은 최근 이스라엘에 대한 하마스 공격 이후 고조된 긴장에 대응하기 위해 로이드 오스틴 국방장관이 승인한 조치입니다. 제럴드 R. 포드 항공모함 전단에는 포드 자체, USS 노르망디, USS 토마스 허드너, USS 라미지, USS 카니, USS 루스벨트가 포함되어 있으며, 원래 6개월 파견을 마치려던 시점에 연장이 결정됐습니다. 새 종료 시점은 아직 공개되지 않았습니다. 두 번째 항공모함 전단인 USS 드와이트 D. 아이젠하워도 추가 투입될 예정입니다. 두 전단 모두 강력한 해상·공중 전력을 보유해 미국과 동맹의 영향력을 높이고 있습니다. 미국 전투기 증파와 영국 군사 자산 투입도 진행 중인데, 이는 이스라엘 지원과 이란이나 헤즈볼라 등 타 세력의 확전 억제를 위한 조치입니다. 미 국방부는 약 2,000명의 미군 태세를 격상해 즉각적 대응이 가능하도록 했으나, 구체적인 추가 파병 결정은 나오지 않았습니다. 사브리나 싱 대변인은 이러한 조치가 중동의 안보 상황 변화에 대한 준비라고 밝혔습니다. 하마스가 이스라엘 남부를 공격해 1,300명 이상이 사망하고 4,000명 넘게 부상당한 뒤, 이스라엘은 가자지구에 대규모 공습을 실시했습니다. 유엔 집계에 따르면 팔레스타인인 2,800명 이상이 숨지고 거의 1만 1천명이 부상했으며, 거주지 파괴도 심각합니다. 이스라엘은 북부 가자 주민 대피를 지시했으나, 인권 단체들은 인도적 재앙이 심화되고 있다며 비판하고 있습니다. 이스라엘 정부는 지상 공격을 준비 중이라고 시사했지만, 구체적 일정은 알려지지 않았습니다. 조 바이든 미국 대통령은 이스라엘과 요르단을 방문해 이스라엘 총리, 요르단 국왕, 이집트 대통령, 팔레스타인자치정부 수반 등과 만날 예정입니다. 토니 블링컨 국무장관은 이번 방문이 매우 중요한 시점에 이루어진다며 미국이 이스라엘 안보를 확고히 지지함을 강조했습니다.

article_content: On Wednesday, excitement for Powerball soared as people throughout the United States queued up for the $1.2 billion jackpot. Since there was no winner, the estimated prize for Saturday’s drawing has increased to $1.4 billion. The winning numbers for Wednesday were 9, 35, 54, 63, 64, with the red Powerball number 1, and a Power Play multiplier of 2. This current jackpot is the third biggest in Powerball history and ranks seventh among all U.S. lottery prizes. Powerball estimates that the lump-sum cash payout would have been about $551.7 million. The jackpot has been growing since July 19, when a $1.08 billion win occurred in California, now reaching 32 consecutive drawings without a jackpot winner. Providence, Rhode Island resident Aldren Diaz shared with local ABC affiliate WLNE that he hopes to help his family and leave a lasting legacy if he wins. Another Rhode Island player, Ramona Perez, said she would use the prize to help her family and support children in her home country. Lottery officials emphasize that while the odds of winning the jackpot are 1 in 292.2 million, chances of winning a smaller prize are much better at 1 in 24.9. In Wednesday’s drawing, seven tickets from California (2), Colorado, New York, Pennsylvania, and Texas (2) each won $1 million by matching five white balls. Three other tickets from Kentucky, Pennsylvania, and Texas matched five white balls with Power Play to win $2 million each. Powerball Product Group Chair Drew Svitko anticipates a surge in ticket purchases leading up to each drawing. He advises participants to sign their tickets and contact their local lottery offices if they win. Powerball tickets cost $2 and are sold in 45 states, plus Washington, D.C., Puerto Rico, and the U.S. Virgin Islands. Jackpot winners may choose a lump-sum payout or 30 annual installments over 29 years. Both options are before federal and jurisdictional taxes. Drawings are held live every Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday at 10:59 p.m. ET from the Florida Lottery studio in Tallahassee, and are also streamed online at Powerball.com.

Malcolm Butler, a rookie cornerback for the New England Patriots who joined the team as an undrafted free agent, became a Super Bowl hero after intercepting Seahawks quarterback Russell Wilson in the final minute of Super Bowl XLIX. The dramatic play, which sealed a 28-24 victory for New England, came after Butler followed advice from coach Bill Belichick, who had warned that such a pass play might occur. Butler, nicknamed 'Scrap' for his relentless effort in practice, credits an inspiring message from an Uber driver—delivered to his mother the night before—for giving him confidence. Butler said, 'I prayed, played as hard as I could, and it worked out.'

Growing up in Vicksburg, Mississippi, Butler faced significant hardships. His mother worked two jobs to support him and his four siblings, and Butler himself worked part-time at Popeyes after being dismissed early from Hinds Community College. He later fought his way onto the football team at the University of West Alabama.

Following the Super Bowl win, Butler expressed his desire to make his mother proud and to serve as an inspiration to young people, emphasizing determination and faith.

The interception was not only pivotal on the field but also became the most tweeted moment of the night, peaking at around 395,000 tweets per minute. Teammates and coaches, including Vince Wilfork and Tom Brady, lauded Butler's game-defining performance, remarking on the fairytale ending to his rookie season.

article_content: Diane Sawyer, long-time anchor of ABC World News, will deliver her final broadcast on August 27, 2014, concluding a five-year tenure as one of America’s most prominent news anchors. At 68, she announced her departure a day ahead of schedule, tweeting: 'See you tonight for my last anchoring - great adventures ahead!' This marks the fourth anchor change at ABC since Peter Jennings' death in 2005. Sawyer’s successor, David Muir, frequently filled in during her absences and will officially step into the anchor role starting September 2, 2014. Sources say Sawyer decided to leave on her own terms, quietly sharing her plans with only a few close friends and seeking a slower pace. She will remain with ABC News in a new capacity, leading an investigative reporting unit, though reportedly at a lower salary than her anchor position. Many team members for this unit already work on Nightline and Good Morning America. Sawyer’s distinguished career highlights include becoming the first female correspondent for CBS’s 60 Minutes in 1984 and conducting high-profile interviews with figures such as President Obama, Saddam Hussein, Fidel Castro, Jaycee Dugard, Amanda Knox, and First Lady Michelle Obama. Under her helm, ABC World News has recently achieved its highest ratings in five years, attracting an average audience of 7.36 million viewers and surpassing competitors in the coveted adult 25-54 demographic according to Nielsen. Sawyer is expected to return for prime-time specials and major interviews. ABC is quietly optimistic that her final broadcast will draw a large audience as she bids farewell.
translated_content: ABC 월드 뉴스의 오랜 앵커 다이앤 소여가 2014년 8월 27일 마지막 방송을 진행하며, 5년간 미국을 대표하는 뉴스 앵커로서의 임기를 마무리합니다. 68세의 소여는 예정일보다 하루 일찍 하차를 발표하며 트위터에 ‘오늘 밤 마지막 앵커링에서 만나요 - 더 멋진 모험이 기다리고 있어요!’라고 글을 남겼습니다. 이는 2005년 피터 제닝스 사망 이후 ABC가 네 번째로 앵커를 교체하는 일입니다. 소여의 후임자인 데이비드 뮤어는 그동안 소여의 부재 시 자주 대타로 앵커 자리에 앉아왔으며, 2014년 9월 2일부터 공식적으로 앵커 역할을 맡게 됩니다. 소식통에 따르면 소여는 자신의 뜻에 따라 조용히 몇몇 가까운 친구들에게만 알리고 은퇴를 결정했으며, 이제는 좀 더 여유로운 삶을 원한다고 전해졌습니다. 소여는 ABC 뉴스에 남아 조사 보도 유닛을 새롭게 이끌 예정이며, 이전보다 적은 급여를 받게 된다고 알려졌습니다. 이 유닛 멤버 상당수는 이미 나이트라인과 굿모닝 아메리카에서 활동 중입니다. 소여는 1984년 CBS ‘60 미닛츠’의 최초 여성 특파원이 되었고, 오바마 대통령, 사담 후세인, 피델 카스트로, 제이시 듀가드, 아만다 녹스, 미셸 오바마 영부인 등 세계 각국 주요 인물과의 인터뷰로 명성을 쌓았습니다. 그녀가 이끌던 기간 동안 ABC 월드 뉴스는 최근 5년 만에 최고 시청률(평균 736만 명)을 기록했고, 닐슨에 따르면 25-54세 성인 시청률에서도 경쟁사를 앞질렀습니다. 소여는 앞으로도 프라임타임 특집이나 주요 인터뷰에 출연할 예정입니다. ABC 측은 그녀의 마지막 방송이 높은 시청률을 기록할 것으로 기대하고 있습니다.

article_content: World of Warcraft turns 20 next year, and the Warcraft franchise as a whole will celebrate its 30-year anniversary. In anticipation of these milestones, Blizzard made major announcements related to Warcraft at BlizzCon 2023. The company revealed a new mobile game, hinted at upcoming updates for World of Warcraft Classic and Hearthstone, and announced three new World of Warcraft expansions called The Worldsoul Saga. According to John Hight, general manager for the Warcraft franchise, these developments are meant to show players Blizzard’s continued commitment to the Warcraft universe. 'We wanted to tell our players that we’re doubling down on [World of Warcraft’s] story. Many of our players have told us over the last two expansions that story is so important,' Hight told Digital Trends in an interview at BlizzCon 2023. He mentioned that Blizzard is typically secretive with plans, but fans wanted more information about the future, which required careful disclosure without revealing too much. During BlizzCon 2023, Digital Trends also spoke to Hight and Vik Saraf, executive producer for Warcraft Rumble, about the future of the Warcraft franchise. Both leaders indicated that the series shows no signs of slowing down in MMO, mobile, or real-time strategy genres. Hight expressed the goal of releasing World of Warcraft expansions more frequently in the coming years. The Worldsoul Saga, which comprises three expansions—The War Within, Midnight, and The Last Titan—will be especially significant for dedicated World of Warcraft players. Hight explained that the story was too large to be contained in a single expansion, and spreading it across three would allow for more depth and payoff. World of Warcraft has received regular expansions since its 2004 debut, with no plans to slow down as Blizzard prepares the culmination of a two-decade-long story. Hight confirmed that The Worldsoul Saga marks the end of a major chapter, not the end of the game, and expansions will continue beyond it. Currently, only The War Within has an expected release window, set for 2024. Hight discussed the desire to accelerate expansion releases, though he could not promise specific dates for the following chapters. He noted that recent improvements in production could enable a more predictable schedule, aiming for faster turnaround times. Associate design director Maria Hamilton, in a group Q&A, reinforced that work on the new expansions is happening in parallel. Preparations are underway for 20th-anniversary celebrations, with Hight promising memorable activities. The coverage goes beyond mainline MMO expansions. World of Warcraft Classic continues to introduce new seasons and plans to re-release the Cataclysm expansion. Hearthstone is set for a new expansion and a Battlegrounds duos mode next year. Warcraft 3: Reforged has seen updates aimed at satisfying its player base after a difficult launch. Warcraft Rumble, a new mobile game from Blizzard, recently launched, aiming to reach players across platforms. Early reviews for Warcraft Rumble on iOS and Android have been positive. Blizzard aspires for the game to have a lasting presence, similar to Hearthstone and World of Warcraft. Vik Saraf stated that Blizzard’s goal is to create 'forever games' and credited their engaged community for supporting game longevity. Plans for anniversary events involving Warcraft Rumble are still being finalized. The future may also involve more real-time strategy titles, with Hight expressing admiration for strategy games and envisioning further expansion into different game genres. Hight drew parallels to companies like Disney and Marvel in building enduring universes. He emphasized the importance of stewardship and laying a foundation for future developers to carry Warcraft forward into new forms and platforms. Disclosure: Blizzard Entertainment and PR agency TriplePoint paid for accommodations for Digital Trends to attend BlizzCon 2023.

article_content: The search for the perfect selfie has turned Mission Peak in Fremont, California, from a quiet park into a crowded destination with thousands of hikers. The influx has led to trail erosion and frequent emergency calls for dehydration and sprained ankles. A few years ago, Mission Peak was relatively quiet, but with the growth of social media, it has become popular among inexperienced hikers hoping to snap photos at the scenic summit pole. East Bay Regional Park Supervisor Gordon Willey told SFGate, 'Some days it's like a rock concert. Ten years ago this was just a quiet little park. But now, with social media, for some reason, it's just blowing up.' Local officials estimate that as many as 3,000 people hike up Mission Peak on busy weekends, far exceeding its intended capacity of 500. The trail is three miles long with a 2,000-foot elevation gain and no shade, making it especially tough on hot, 90-degree days. On busy weekends, health officials are called out four or five times a day, mostly for twisted ankles, dehydration, or heatstroke. Many visitors bring pets, but the harsh conditions have proved dangerous—five dogs died last summer during attempts to climb the peak. District police Lt Lance Brede explained, 'There's no shade and no water, and sometimes people overestimate their abilities. They get halfway up, and then we get a phone call. It pulls our resources away from other things.' In response, local authorities have started enforcing a curfew and posting signs warning hikers to bring water and proper shoes. They're also considering parking fees and removing the summit pole to reduce crowds. Hikers often take shortcuts off the marked trail, contributing to hillside erosion, and neighbors complain about increased traffic. Sidney Salenga, a chef from San Jose, said before a hike, 'I saw some people posted pictures from the very top, and I thought, I want to go there.'
translated_content: 최고의 셀카를 찍으려는 열기로 캘리포니아 프리몬트의 미션피크가 한적하던 공원에서 수천 명이 몰리는 명소로 변했습니다. 그 결과 등산로 침식은 물론 탈수와 발목 부상 등 응급 상황도 잦아졌습니다. 몇 년 전만 해도 미션피크는 꽤 조용했지만, 소셜 미디어의 영향으로 경험이 적은 등산객들까지 정상 포토존을 노리고 몰려들고 있습니다. 이스트 베이 지역공원 담당자 고든 윌리는 SFGate 인터뷰에서 '어떤 날은 마치 락 콘서트 같아요. 10년 전만 해도 정말 조용한 공원이었는데, 소셜 미디어 때문에 갑자기 대박이 났어요'라고 전했습니다. 현지 관계자에 따르면 미션피크는 바쁜 주말이면 하루 최대 3,000명이 찾는데, 원래는 약 500명 정도 수용하도록 설계된 곳입니다. 등산로는 3마일에 2,000피트 높이이며 전 구간 그늘이 없어 여름철 90도(화씨) 더위에는 상당히 어렵습니다. 바쁜 주말이면 보건 당국이 발목 염좌, 탈수, 열사병 등의 문제로 하루 4~5번 출동합니다. 반려동물을 동반하는 경우도 많은데, 힘든 환경으로 인해 지난해에는 다섯 마리 반려견이 목숨을 잃었습니다. 경찰 중위 랜스 브리드는 '그늘도 없고 물도 없는데, 종종 등산 능력을 과대평가한 분들이 중턱쯤에서 신고를 하세요. 이 때문에 다른 업무에 투입할 자원을 빼앗깁니다'라고 밝혔습니다. 이에 당국은 통행금지와 물·신발 준비 안내판 설치 등 안전 조치를 강화하고, 주말 주차비 부과와 정상 봉 제거도 검토 중입니다. 많은 사람들이 샛길로 다니면서 산사면 침식이 심해졌고, 인근 주민들은 등산객 때문에 늘어난 교통체증에도 불만을 표합니다. 산호세 출신 셰프 시드니 살렌가는 '정상에서 찍은 사진을 SNS에서 보고 나도 가보고 싶었다'고 말했습니다.

Quinton de Kock scored his fourth century at the Cricket World Cup, leading South Africa to a commanding 190-run win over New Zealand on November 1. Having announced his retirement from One-Day Internationals before the tournament, de Kock is making the most of his final ODI appearances. He currently tops the tournament's run charts with 545 runs at an average of 77.85 and a strike rate of 112.60.

Fellow batter Rassie van der Dussen, who also scored a century and shared a 200-run stand with de Kock in the match against New Zealand, highlighted de Kock’s impact and leadership. Van der Dussen stated, 'He’s involved in all aspects of the team and provides valuable guidance, both on and off the field. His calm and clear thinking makes him a great partner to bat with.'

Out of seven pool matches, South Africa have won six, suffering just one upset against the Netherlands. Van der Dussen also praised the contributions from all team members, including substitutes like Tabraiz Shamsi, demonstrating the squad's depth and unity.

South Africa will next face the unbeaten host nation, India, with top position in the pool likely at stake. Although Van der Dussen acknowledged the strength of the Indian team, he expressed confidence in South Africa’s approach and preparation.

article_content: The Russian military has reported that a Ukrainian missile strike on a shipyard in annexed Crimea damaged a Russian vessel. According to the Russian Defense Ministry, Ukrainian forces launched 15 cruise missiles at the Zaliv shipyard in Kerch, a city located in the eastern part of the Crimean Peninsula, late Saturday. Russian air defenses intercepted 13 of the missiles, but some struck the shipyard and damaged a vessel, the ministry stated. The ministry did not provide details about the ship or the extent of the damage. Mykola Oleshchuk, the commander of Ukraine's air force, said in a statement that at the time of the attack, 'one of the most modern ships of Russia's Black Sea fleet—a carrier of the Kalibr cruise missiles—was at the shipyard.' He did not explicitly confirm whether this particular ship was damaged in the strike. The Crimean Peninsula, which Russia annexed from Ukraine in 2014, has frequently been targeted since Russian President Vladimir Putin ordered a full-scale invasion of Ukraine 20 months ago. Crimea has played a key role as a hub for supporting Russia's invasion. Ukraine has increasingly targeted naval facilities in Crimea in recent months. In September, a Ukrainian missile strike on a strategic shipyard in Sevastopol damaged two Russian ships and wounded 24 people. Later that month, another missile strike hit the Crimean headquarters of Russia's navy in Sevastopol. Commenting on Saturday's strike, Andriy Yermak, head of Ukraine's presidential office, wrote on Telegram Sunday morning, 'Life constantly proves that there will be no (Russia's) Black Sea fleet in Crimea.'

article_content:
Alastair Cook praised England’s near-perfect performance after they claimed their first Test victory in almost a year, defeating India by 266 runs in the third Investec Test at the Ageas Bowl. This win ended a 10-match winless streak for England, which had included just two draws. Cook said, 'It was a good performance right from day one. I don’t think we lost a session. Every single member of the XI contributed to a great win. Scoring 570 in the first innings was a great start, and then we bowled India out, scored quickly, put them under pressure, and bowled them out again.'

The victory was particularly special for Moeen Ali, Sam Robson, Gary Ballance, and Chris Woakes, who all celebrated their first Test win. Cook remarked, 'There was a bit of a scramble for the stumps for their first win—it’s something people will remember for a long time.'

Cook himself eased concerns over his batting form with a commanding 95 in the first innings, helping set the stage for big centuries from Ballance and Ian Bell and an aggressive 85 from debutant wicketkeeper Jos Buttler. 'I said at Lord’s I thought my game was heading back in the right direction, and to back it up here, I’m incredibly pleased,' Cook said. 'I was frustrated not to get the hundred, but to score 160 runs in the match is something I’ll certainly take.'

James Anderson was named man of the match after taking five wickets for 53 runs in the first innings and seven wickets overall, while Moeen Ali wrapped up India’s second innings with six wickets for 67 runs. Cook noted, 'Moeen’s bowling has come on leaps and bounds since the beginning of the summer. Credit to him—he’s worked incredibly hard. He’s backed up Saeed Ajmal at Worcestershire and has bowled a lot in the nets with our squad.'

On Buttler's debut, Cook commented, 'It was an outstanding debut. He came in at the perfect moment, played aggressively, and it was great to watch. The best part is no one’s talking about his keeping—he had a good all-round game.'

알래스터 쿡은 인도에 266점 차로 승리하며 거의 1년 만에 첫 테스트 경기 승리를 거둔 영국팀의 완벽에 가까운 경기력을 칭찬했습니다. 이번 세 번째 인베스텍 테스트(에이지스 보울)에서의 승리로 영국은 10경기 연속 무승, 단 두 번의 무승부만 거뒀던 흐름을 끊어냈습니다. 쿡은 "첫날부터 모든 면에서 좋은 경기력이었어요. 한 세션도 내주지 않았던 것 같아요. 11명 모두가 대승에 기여했습니다. 첫 이닝에 570점을 올린 것이 좋은 출발이었고, 이후 인도를 아웃시키고 빠르게 점수를 추가해 그들에게 압박을 가한 뒤 다시 아웃시켰죠."라고 말했습니다.

이번 승리는 특히 모인 알리, 샘 롭슨, 게리 밸런스, 크리스 웍스 등 첫 테스트 승리를 경험한 선수들에게 더욱 뜻깊었습니다. 쿡은 "이 선수들이 첫 승을 기념하기 위해 스텀프를 쟁탈하던 모습이 있었는데, 오랫동안 기억될 거예요."라고 덧붙였습니다.

쿡 자신도 첫 이닝에서 95점을 기록하면서 자신의 폼에 대한 의문을 잠재웠고, 밸런스와 이안 벨의 대형 득점, 데뷔전 포수 조스 버틀러의 공격적인 85점이 그 기반이 되었습니다. 쿡은 "로드에서 내 경기가 나아지고 있다는 느낌이 들었는데, 여기서 이를 증명해 보여 정말 기쁩니다. 100점을 채우지 못해 아쉬웠지만, 전체 경기에서 160점을 올려 만족합니다."라고 말했습니다.

제임스 앤더슨은 첫 이닝 53실점 5위켓, 전체 7위켓을 따내며 MOM(경기 최우수 선수)에 선정되었고, 모인 알리는 인도의 두 번째 이닝에서 67실점 6위켓을 기록하며 공헌했습니다. 쿡은 "모인의 볼링이 이번 여름 초에 비해 큰 발전을 보였어요. 정말 많은 노력을 했고, 우스터셔에서 사이드 아즈말을 백업하며 우리 선수들과도 네트에서 많이 훈련했죠."라고 전했습니다.

버틀러에 대해서는 "정말 인상적인 데뷔였습니다. 결정적인 순간에 들어와 공격적으로 경기했고, 보는 사람들도 즐거웠죠. 무엇보다 그의 포수 역할에 대해 아무도 언급할 필요 없을 만큼 전반적으로 훌륭한 경기를 펼쳤어요."라고 평가했습니다.

article_content: Injections of Botox, commonly used to treat wrinkles, can now be used to manage bladder dysfunction in women. The National Institute for Health and Clinical Excellence (NICE) has approved the drug for people with overactive bladder—a common cause of incontinence—when other treatments do not work. Up to one in five people in England and Wales are affected, experiencing symptoms such as frequent, urgent urges to urinate. According to Mr. Andrew Hextall, a consultant urogynaecologist at Spire Bushey Hospital and St Albans City Hospital in Hertfordshire, 'Botox provides significant improvements for many, allowing them to return to a normal lifestyle.' Botox is a prescription medicine containing small amounts of highly purified botulinum toxin. When injected into muscles, it temporarily paralyzes them. Clinical trials have shown success in treating urinary incontinence, which led NICE to approve Botox for this use. The drug works by paralyzing the bladder muscles to stop unwanted contractions, but its effects last only six to eight months, so repeat injections are needed. Patients are encouraged to try lifestyle adjustments, such as reducing caffeine and alcohol and doing pelvic-floor exercises, before considering Botox. Both men and women can develop an overactive bladder, but women, especially those over 40, are twice as likely to experience it. Causes can include diabetes, infection, bladder stones, or spinal injury, but often the cause is unknown.
translated_content: 주로 주름 제거에 사용되는 보톡스 주사가 이제 여성의 방광 기능 장애 치료에도 활용될 수 있습니다. 영국 국립보건임상우수연구원(NICE)은 다른 치료법이 효과가 없는 경우 과민성 방광(요실금의 주요 원인) 환자에게 보톡스 사용을 승인했습니다. 잉글랜드와 웨일스 인구 중 최대 5명 중 1명이 이 증상으로 고통받으며, 대표적 증상은 잦은 소변 마려움과 급박뇨입니다. 허트퍼드셔의 스파이어 부시 병원 및 세인트 알반스 시티 병원 산부인과 전문의 앤드루 헥스톨에 따르면, "보톡스는 많은 환자에게 현저한 개선 효과를 주어 일상생활로의 복귀를 돕습니다"라고 전했습니다. 보톡스는 고도로 정제된 소량의 보툴리눔 독소가 들어 있는 처방약으로, 근육에 주사하면 일시적으로 마비를 일으킵니다. 임상시험을 통해 요실금 치료 효과가 입증되었으며, 이에 따라 NICE에서 방광 치료에 보톡스를 승인했습니다. 이 약물은 방광 근육을 마비시켜 불필요한 수축을 막지만, 효과는 6~8개월 정도로 지속되어 반복 시술이 필요합니다. 보톡스 시술 전에는 카페인과 알코올 줄이기, 골반저 근육 운동 등 생활습관 개선이 우선 권장됩니다. 남성과 여성 모두 과민성 방광이 생길 수 있지만 특히 40세 이상 여성에게 두 배로 흔합니다. 원인은 당뇨, 감염, 방광 결석, 척수 손상 등이 있으며, 대부분은 정확한 원인을 알 수 없습니다.

article_content: Ahead of their World Cup semifinal match against New Zealand, the Indian cricket team conducted an optional training session on Tuesday. Fast bowlers Jasprit Bumrah and Mohammed Shami sat out the session to rest following a recent match in Bengaluru and the subsequent trip to Mumbai. While some team members prioritized recovery, others, like captain Rohit Sharma and seasoned batter Virat Kohli, actively participated. Kohli faced deliveries from fast bowler Mohammed Siraj, spinners, and throwdown specialists across all practice nets. Ravindra Jadeja took an extended batting session before joining fielding drills with coach T Dilip. Spinner Ravichandran Ashwin, who last played in the team’s tournament opener, also spent significant time bowling during practice. Notably, Shubman Gill, KL Rahul, and Shreyas Iyer were absent from the session. To keep the team spirit high, captain Rohit Sharma highlighted the need for a positive and stable team environment that doesn't fluctuate with on-field outcomes. Speaking at a press conference at Wankhede Stadium, he stressed the importance of every player and support staff member contributing to a cohesive atmosphere. Team bonding is also a priority, with recent activities including a fashion show during a break in Dharamshala, aimed at helping players relax. Rohit underscored the value of such initiatives for managing the inevitable pressures of high-stakes matches. 'There’s always pressure when we’re on the field, but off the field, we do everything to make sure the atmosphere is positive and easygoing,' he said ahead of the semifinal. In business updates, India's economy is projected to have grown by 6.7% in the July-September 2023 period, largely thanks to strong performance in the service sector. Additionally, telecom companies and related industries have expressed reservations about quickly implementing technology that broadcasts TV content directly to mobile devices without data connections. Meanwhile, the government is considering raising the GST evasion prosecution threshold from ₹2 crore to ₹3 crore to streamline business processes and lessen unnecessary legal action.

article_content: A rental house in Queensland has been left severely damaged after tenants Kerris and Nicole Rex allegedly trashed the property and disappeared, leaving the landlord responsible for cleaning up an estimated $30,000 worth of damage. According to A Current Affair, Kerris and Nicole Rex have not been seen or heard from in about a week. The landlord, Viv, describes the property as a 'house of horrors,' filled with rubbish, holes in the walls, blood stains, rats nesting in the stove, and cigarette butts in the bathtub. Broken windows, blocked pipes, and non-functioning toilets further describe the state of the house. The landlord reported finding over 25 empty alcohol bottles in the kitchen, with some smashed in cupboards, along with syringes and drug paraphernalia. Nicole's father, Greg, says he is worried about his daughter and wants her to come home, expressing concern that she may be in danger. He says that before Nicole met Kerris, she 'was a normal kid.' He also blames Kerris for the current situation. Neighbours have reported feeling threatened and abused by the tenants. Jane Brown, a neighbour, told A Current Affair that Kerris allegedly confronted her with a steel hammer. The police are reportedly searching for Kerris and Nicole Rex, who have been missing for about a week.

Iranian President Ebrahim Raisi emphasized on Saturday that immediate action is needed regarding the conflict in Gaza, rather than continued discussion, as he departed for Saudi Arabia to participate in a summit addressing the war between Israel and Hamas. "Gaza is not a place for words, but for action," Raisi remarked at Tehran airport before leaving for the meeting of Arab and Islamic nations in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. He further underscored the importance of unity among Islamic countries at this time.

This trip marks the first visit to Saudi Arabia by an Iranian head of state since Tehran and Riyadh restored diplomatic ties in March through a China-brokered agreement. Iranian Foreign Minister Hossein Amirabdollahian, accompanying Raisi, stated on the Padolat government website that the summit aims to send a strong message to those fueling conflict in the region and to bring about an end to war crimes in Palestine.

Raisi, speaking to reporters, criticized the United States, saying its statements about not wanting the war to expand do not align with its actions. "The war machine in Gaza is operated by America, which is hindering a ceasefire and expanding the conflict," Raisi said. "The world must see America's true role in this war."

article_content: The late, distinguished sports writer Ian Wooldridge was present ringside for Muhammad Ali's iconic 'Rumble in the Jungle' bout against George Foreman in Zaire in 1974. This is his report from Kinshasa the morning after that historic fight. As the sun rose over Central Africa yesterday, Muhammad Ali was still addressing the world. His main message: he would require $10 million to step into the ring for his next fight—a sum amounting to just over £4 million an hour, or twice what he received for defeating Foreman. This, he claimed, was the price for performing his next miracle in the ring. Ali knocked out George Foreman in the eighth round, reclaiming the world heavyweight title. Wooldridge describes the victory as unforgettable, noting that by the end of the fight Ali had landed 65 clean blows to Foreman’s face. Ali famously used his 'rope-a-dope' strategy—absorbing Foreman's punches to tire him out. Foreman, known for his honesty, later admitted, 'A boxer never sees the big one that hits him.' The final combination—a fast sequence of punches ending with a left hook and a right—put Foreman down for the first time in his professional career. Dazed, he struggled even to count along with the referee. Foreman was so confused by Ali’s tactics that he threw wild punches and even nearly fell through the ropes. Throughout the fight, Ali talked to Foreman during clinches and conversed with a black American reporter between rounds. In the fifth round, Ali leaned so far back on the ropes that he was almost on the commentators’ laps, using only his forearms and gloves to defend himself. Ali took risks and showcased remarkable skill and bravery, just as he had promised his fans. The bout, rumored to be Ali’s $5 million retirement fight, played out exactly as he predicted—he would be the matador, Foreman the bull. Even after winning, moments after Foreman was counted out, Ali was knocked down amid the chaos of jubilant supporters rushing into the ring. 'I'm going to haunt boxing for the next six months,' Ali declared, saying he’d only talk to the first person who offered him $10 million. Ian Wooldridge’s vivid account captures the drama and spectacle of Ali’s performance. Wooldridge was honored with numerous awards during his nearly 50-year career with the Daily Mail before his passing in 2007. This article is an abridged version of his report, also featured in his book 'Searching for Heroes: 50 Years of Sporting Encounters.'

article_content: Paul McCartney and Ringo Starr, the two surviving members of the Beatles, are set to reunite for the special event 'The Night That Changed America: A Grammys Salute to The Beatles.' The show celebrates 50 years since the Beatles' arrival in New York in February 1964 and their famous debut on 'The Ed Sullivan Show.' Ringo Starr revealed the news at a David Lynch Foundation event, where he received the Lifetime of Peace and Love Award. The Recording Academy had already announced that both McCartney and Starr will perform at the Grammy Awards on Sunday, though it's not confirmed if they will perform together. Both musicians will receive a Lifetime Achievement Award at Sunday's Grammy ceremony. The 'Grammys Salute' will be taped on January 27 and will air on CBS on February 9, marking the exact anniversary of the landmark Ed Sullivan Show performance. This was the occasion when most Americans saw the Beatles live for the first time, shortly after their single 'I Want to Hold Your Hand' reached number one. Performers at the Grammy Salute will include Alicia Keys, John Legend, Keith Urban, and the reunited Eurythmics. If McCartney and Starr share the stage, it will be their first joint performance since a 2010 concert for Starr's 70th birthday; prior to that, they played together at a 2009 David Lynch Foundation event. The band's other members, John Lennon and George Harrison, died in 1980 and 2001, respectively. Additionally, previously unreleased 1963 Beatles tracks have recently become available on iTunes.

'그래미 살루트'는 1월 27일 녹화되어 2월 9일 CBS에서 방송될 예정인데, 이는 비틀즈가 에드 설리번 쇼에 첫 등장한 바로 그 날과 동일합니다. 이 공연은 대부분의 미국인들이 비틀즈의 라이브를 처음 본 순간이었으며, 그 전 비틀즈의 싱글 'I Want to Hold Your Hand'가 1위를 차지했습니다. 이번 그래미 살루트에는 알리샤 키스, 존 레전드, 키스 어번, 그리고 재결합한 유리드믹스가 출연할 예정입니다. 만약 매카트니와 스타가 무대를 함께 한다면, 이는 2010년 스타의 70번째 생일을 기념한 공연 이후 처음이 됩니다. 그 전에는 2009년 데이비드 린치 재단 행사에서 함께한 적이 있습니다. 비틀즈의 다른 멤버인 존 레논과 조지 해리슨은 각각 1980년과 2001년에 세상을 떠났습니다. 또한 1963년 녹음된 비틀즈의 미공개 곡들이 최근 아이튠즈에 공개됐습니다.

article_content:
Deep in the Western Australian bush lives a tiny species of jumping spider called Maratus avibus, commonly known as the peacock spider. These spiders, found only near Cape Arid, Western Australia, are known for their elaborate and colorful courtship dances. The male peacock spider displays vibrant blue, red, and green flaps on its abdomen, which it raises and waves to attract females. This stunning performance is similar to the displays of peacock birds, which is the origin of the spider’s nickname.

The detailed mating ritual, rarely captured on camera, was photographed by biologist Dr. Jurgen Otto and his colleague David Knowles near Esperance. When a male detects a nearby female, he lifts his legs and flashes his abdomen in a series of rhythmic movements. Female spiders carefully observe the male’s colors, vibrations, and display patterns to assess his health and to ensure he is the correct species.

After mating, a male peacock spider will try to repeat his courtship dance with as many females as possible—Maratus spiders can have multiple partners. Notably, males are not selective and may court females from other Maratus species as well. The genus Maratus is part of the Salticidae family of jumping spiders. 

Dr. Otto, who is based in Sydney, discovered Maratus avibus in October and remarked that many species in this group remain unnamed, though some are recognized by scientists and photographers. The specific name 'avibus', meaning 'birds', was chosen because the markings on the spider’s abdomen resemble two birds facing each other. Although it was once believed that the colorful abdominal flaps helped the spiders glide—earning them the nickname 'gliding spiders'—research has shown these flaps serve mainly for mating displays.

서호주 오지 깊은 곳에는 모라투스 아비부스(Maratus avibus)라는 아주 작은 점프거미, 일명 공작거미가 서식합니다. 이 거미는 서호주 케이프 애리드(Cape Arid) 근처에서만 발견되며, 화려하고 정교한 구애 댄스로 유명하죠. 수컷 공작거미는 파란색, 빨간색, 초록색의 눈에 띄는 배의 판을 펼쳐 암컷을 유혹합니다. 이는 공작새의 구애와 비슷해 거미의 별명도 여기서 비롯됐습니다.

이 구애 의식은 좀처럼 카메라에 담기 어려운데, 생물학자 유르겐 오토 박사(Dr. Jurgen Otto)와 동료 데이비드 놀스(David Knowles)가 에스페란스 근처에서 촬영에 성공했습니다. 수컷은 암컷의 존재를 감지하면 다리를 들고 배를 번쩍이며 리드미컬하게 움직입니다. 암컷은 색, 진동, 움직임 등을 꼼꼼히 살펴 건강 상태와 종이 맞는지 판단합니다.

교미에 성공한 수컷은 가능한 한 많은 암컷과 또다시 이 댄스를 펼치며, 모라투스 거미는 여러 파트너와 교미할 수 있습니다. 특히 수컷은 까다롭지 않아 다른 모라투스 종의 암컷에게도 구애를 합니다. 모라투스(Maratus) 속은 점프거미 과(Salticidae)에 속합니다.

시드니에 거주하는 오토 박사는 지난해 10월 이 종을 발견했고, 아직 이름 붙여지지 않은 모라투스 거미가 많다고 했습니다. '아비부스(avibus)'라는 이름은 거미 배 무늬가 마주 보는 두 마리 새처럼 보여 붙여졌습니다. 예전에는 이 화려한 판이 점프 시 활강을 돕는다고 여겨져 ‘글라이딩 거미’라고 불리기도 했지만, 연구 결과 이 판은 주로 구애를 위한 것임이 밝혀졌습니다.

article_content: WASHINGTON: The US Congress recently passed a 45-day stopgap funding measure to avert a government shutdown, but this temporary solution has left strategic Pacific island states facing potential funding gaps. Analysts and former officials warn that these shortfalls may leave US allies in the Pacific economically vulnerable and potentially more open to Chinese influence. The Biden administration had sought to see Congress approve new 20-year funding agreements for Micronesia, the Marshall Islands, and Palau by September 30. These three sparsely populated nations are now at the forefront of US efforts to counter China's growing presence in the Northern Pacific. The US maintains close ties with these nations through Compacts of Free Association (COFAs), under which Washington is responsible for their defense and provides economic assistance, in exchange for exclusive military access to vital areas of the Pacific. New funding packages for the Marshall Islands and Micronesia were due for renewal by the end of September, with Palau's agreement set to expire at the end of fiscal 2024. Earlier this year, Washington and the island states reached a preliminary agreement for a new $7.1 billion, 20-year funding package, pending Congressional approval. However, the recent continuing resolution (CR) passed by Congress to avoid a federal shutdown did not include funding for this new program. While the CR maintains federal services for the COFA states, it leaves significant gaps in other parts of their budgets. "Keeping existing services operational is important, but the CR will make things quite difficult for the Marshall Islands, which has an election on November 20, and for Palau, which plans to hold an election next year," said Cleo Paskal, a specialist in COFA issues at the Foundation for Defense of Democracies.
translated_content: 워싱턴: 미국 의회가 최근 45일간의 임시 예산안을 통과시켜 연방정부 셧다운은 피했지만, 이로 인해 전략적 태평양 섬 국가들이 잠재적 예산 부족에 직면하게 됐습니다. 전문가들과 전직 관계자들은 이러한 재정적 차질이 미국의 태평양 동맹국들을 경제적으로 더 취약하게 만들고, 중국의 영향력에 더 쉽게 노출될 수 있다고 경고합니다. 바이든 행정부는 미크로네시아, 마셜제도, 팔라우와의 새로운 20년간 자금 지원 협정을 9월 30일까지 의회에서 승인받기를 원했습니다. 인구는 적지만 영토가 넓은 이 세 국가는 현재 북태평양에서 중국의 세력 확대에 맞서는 미국의 주요 전략 파트너입니다. 미국은 자유연합협정(COFA)을 통해 이들 국가와 긴밀한 관계를 맺고 있습니다. 이 협정에 따라 미국은 이들 나라의 국방을 보장하고 경제 지원을 제공하는 대신, 전략적으로 중요한 태평양 해역에 독점적인 군사 접근권을 갖게 됩니다. 마셜제도와 미크로네시아의 자금 지원 패키지는 9월 말까지 갱신되어야 했고, 팔라우의 협정은 2024년 회계연도 말에 만료될 예정입니다. 올해 초 미국과 섬 국가들은 20년간 총 71억 달러의 새로운 지원 패키지에 잠정 합의했으며, 현재 의회의 승인을 기다리고 있습니다. 하지만 최근 의회를 통과한 임시 예산안(CR)은 이 새로운 지원 프로그램의 자금을 포함하지 않았습니다. CR로 인해 COFA 국가들에 대한 연방 서비스는 유지되지만, 예산의 다른 부분에는 상당한 공백이 생기고 있습니다. "기존 서비스의 유지는 중요하지만, CR로 인해 11월 20일 선거를 앞둔 마셜제도와 내년에 선거를 치르는 팔라우는 큰 어려움에 직면할 것입니다."라고 민주주의수호재단의 COFA 전문가 클레오 파스칼은 밝혔습니다.

article_content: Manchester United moved a step closer to Champions League history, beating Arsenal 3-1 at the Emirates Stadium to clinch a 4-1 aggregate victory and secure a spot in the final in Rome. The defending champions silenced the home crowd with two early goals in the first 11 minutes, quickly ending Arsenal fans’ hopes of turning around their first-leg defeat. Arsenal came into the match boasting a 27-game unbeaten European streak at home and had never lost a Champions League fixture at the Emirates. That impressive record fell when United scored in the eighth minute. Cristiano Ronaldo delivered a dangerous cross from the left, Kieran Gibbs slipped, and Ji-Sung Park capitalized, finishing past goalkeeper Manuel Almunia. It was the first goal Arsenal had conceded at home in Europe that season and confirmed manager Alex Ferguson’s choice of Park over Carlos Tevez. Three minutes later, Ronaldo extended United’s lead with a stunning long-range free-kick that caught Almunia by surprise. Despite Almunia’s previous performances, this time he misjudged the ball as it sailed into the net, leaving Arsenal needing three goals to keep their Champions League hopes alive. United continued to press, with Wayne Rooney almost scoring in the 17th minute but being denied by Almunia’s full-stretch save. After the break, Ronaldo nearly added another, again forcing a good stop from Almunia. Arsenal pushed forward for momentum, but United struck again on the counter in the 61st minute. Park started the move, finding Rooney on the left, who then set up Ronaldo for his second goal of the night. With the result already beyond doubt, Arsenal tried to restore pride. Van Persie forced a save from Edwin van der Sar, and substitute Nicklas Bendtner found the side-netting. In the closing stages, Darren Fletcher was controversially sent off for a tackle on Cesc Fabregas resulting in a penalty, which Robin van Persie converted. United manager Alex Ferguson praised his team’s overall performance, lamented Fletcher’s red card and suspension for the final, and remarked on the likely challenge from Chelsea or Barcelona in the Rome showdown.
translated_content: 맨체스터 유나이티드는 아스널을 3-1로 꺾고 총합 4-1로 챔피언스리그 결승에 진출했습니다. 디펜딩 챔피언 맨유는 경기 시작 11분 만에 두 골을 넣어 홈 팬들의 역전 희망을 빠르게 무산시켰습니다. 아스널은 유럽 홈경기 27경기 연속 무패, 에미레이츠 스타디움 챔피언스리그 무패 기록을 가졌으나, 8분 만에 맨유가 선제골을 넣으며 기록이 깨졌습니다. 크리스티아누 호날두의 크로스에 키어런 깁스가 미끄러지며 박지성이 기회를 놓치지 않고 알무니아 골키퍼를 제쳤습니다. 이 골은 아스널이 시즌 유럽 홈경기에서 처음 내준 실점이었으며, 퍼거슨 감독이 카를로스 테베스 대신 박지성을 기용한 이유가 보여졌습니다. 3분 뒤 호날두가 먼 거리 프리킥으로 한 골을 추가했습니다. 지난 경기에서 선방을 펼친 알무니아였지만, 이번에는 볼의 궤도를 잘못 판단했습니다. 아스널은 결승행을 위해 세 골이 필요해졌습니다. 맨유의 공격은 계속됐고, 17분엔 웨인 루니의 슛이 알무니아의 슈퍼세이브에 막혔습니다. 후반에도 호날두가 날카로운 슈팅을 시도했으나 알무니아가 또 막아냈습니다. 아스널은 만회골을 위해 공격에 나섰으나, 61분 박지성이 역습을 이끌어 루니에게 패스했고, 루니는 쇄도하던 호날두에게 넘겨 두 번째 골을 만들어냈습니다. 사실상 승부가 갈린 뒤에도 아스널은 자존심을 걸고 싸웠으나 반 페르시의 중거리 슈팅은 판 데르 사르에게 막히고, 벤트너의 슛은 골대를 벗어났습니다. 경기 막판 대런 플레처가 파브레가스에게 태클해 퇴장당했고, 페널티킥이 선언돼 반 페르시가 성공시켰습니다. 경기 후 알렉스 퍼거슨 감독은 선수들을 칭찬하면서도 플레처의 퇴장과 결승 결장에 아쉬움을 드러냈으며, 결승에서 맞게 될 첼시나 바르셀로나의 도전에 대해 언급했습니다.

article_content: Singapore is expected to remain shrouded in haze on Sunday, largely due to weak winds preventing air pollutants from dissipating. On Saturday, the city’s air quality deteriorated to unhealthy levels for the first time since 2019, as haze from Indonesian forest fires drifted across, according to the National Environment Agency (NEA). The NEA stated in its regular haze update that the subdued wind conditions are likely to prolong the haze over Singapore and nearby regions, with little likelihood of immediate improvement. Still, the agency predicts that showers and a shift in wind patterns, expected on Monday, could help clear the haze and boost air quality. As of 11pm on Saturday, the 24-hour Pollutant Standards Index (PSI) ranged from 67 to 121, peaking in the eastern part of Singapore. The NEA deems PSI readings from 101 to 200 as unhealthy. While PM2.5 fine particle levels rose to elevated values (56 to 150) in central and eastern areas during the day, they had returned to normal by late evening.
translated_content: 싱가포르는 일요일에도 약한 바람으로 인해 공기 오염 물질이 잘 흩어지지 않아 계속해서 흐린 하늘이 이어질 전망입니다. NEA(싱가포르 환경청)에 따르면, 토요일 싱가포르의 대기질은 2019년 이후 처음으로 '나쁨' 단계(PSI 101~200)에 진입했으며, 이는 인도네시아 산불에서 발생한 연무가 유입된 영향입니다. NEA는 정기 연무 정보에서 약한 바람이 싱가포르와 인근 지역에 연무를 장기간 머물게 할 것으로 예상하며, 당장 개선은 어려울 것 같다고 덧붙였습니다. 다만, 월요일에는 예보된 소나기와 바람 방향의 변화로 대기질이 다소 나아질 수 있다고 전망했습니다. 토요일 오후 11시 기준, 24시간 대기오염지수(PSI)는 67~121 사이였고, 동부 지역에서 가장 높은 수치가 관측됐습니다. NEA는 PSI 101~200을 '나쁨'으로 간주합니다. 또, PM2.5(초미세먼지) 농도는 이날 오후 동부와 중부 지역에서 '높음'(56~150) 구간까지 올랐다가 밤에는 정상 수준으로 돌아갔습니다.
